question: Which of the following countries is NOT one of the co-hosts of the ICC 2027 ODI World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kenya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• South Africa, along with Namibia and Zimbabwe host the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup in October/November 2027.
 
• This will be the second time Zimbabwe will host the International Cricket Council (ICC) Cricket World Cup after successfully hosting the 2003 edition of the global tournament with South Africa, and Kenya.
 
• In October/November 2031, the Men’s Cricket World Cup will be played in India and Bangladesh.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• About ICC Men's ODI Cricket World Cup:

 
 
• The Cricket World Cup (officially known as ICC Men's Cricket World Cup) is the international championship of One Day International (ODI) cricket.
 
• The event is organised by the sport's governing body, the International Cricket Council (ICC), every four years, with preliminary qualification rounds leading up to a finals tournament.
 
• The first World Cup was organised in England in June 1975, with the first ODI cricket match having been played only four years earlier.
 
 
 
• Facts about List of ICC Men's ODI Cricket World Cup:
 
 
• First Edition: 1975.
 
• First Winner: West Indies.
 
• Current champion: England (1st title), 2019 World Cup edition, held in England and Wales.
 
• Most successful Team: Australia (5 titles).
 
• India & West Indies are the only two countries which have won the world cup 2 times each.
 
• India won the World Cup in 1983 and 2011, while West Indies won in 1975 and 1979.
